source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The files are read by io-read.R to build ExploratorySummarizedExperiment objects, which the selectmatrix module exposes to the plot modules such as pca, heatmap and volcanoplot. app-composition.R assembles them into applications in apps.R and rnaseq.R.
